meta_description: Gardens & Stuff in Bristol offers professional garden design, maintenance, and landscaping. Local, reliable gardeners serving BS2 and beyond. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Whether it's overgrown borders, a full redesign, or regular upkeep, we'll get your Bristol garden looking its best.
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to complete garden transformations, we handle every aspect of outdoor space design and care.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn mowing, hedge trimming, and border care. Keep your garden looking sharp with fortnightly or monthly visits tailored to your needs.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Transform bare or overgrown space into a functional garden you'll love. We design around your lifestyle and budget, handling planting, hard landscaping, and patios.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional pruning, shaping, and removal of overgrown hedges and trees. Safe, tidy work that encourages healthy new growth.

services.title: Turfing & Seeding
services.desc: Prepare, lay, and seed new lawns. We'll clear the site, level it properly, and install quality turf or oversee establishment of seeded areas.

services.title: Clearance & Tidying
services.desc: Tackle overgrown gardens, jungles of weeds, or accumulated garden waste. We'll clear, haul, and leave your space ready for a fresh start.

services.title: Planting & Seasonal Work
services.desc: Spring and autumn planting of perennials, shrubs, and bedding. We'll advise on what thrives in Bristol's climate and maintain colour year-round.

about_pullquote: A tidy garden isn't a luxury — it's the bit of life you actually use.
about_para_1: Gardens & Stuff has been helping Bristol homeowners reclaim their outdoor space since 2012. We started because we saw too many beautiful gardens left to go to seed, and too many people overwhelmed by where to start. Today, we're the gardeners half of Bristol trusts with their borders, patios, and weekend peace of mind.
about_para_2: We're not flashy, but we're reliable. We show up on time, we listen to what you want, and we don't upsell you on work you don't need. Most of our new clients come from word-of-mouth recommendations, and many have been with us for years. That's the standard we hold ourselves to.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our garden was a complete mess when we moved in — overgrown shrubs, broken fence, nowhere to sit. The lads came in, cleared it all, laid turf, and built us a little patio. Cost less than I expected and the whole thing took three weeks. Brilliant job, no faffing about.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Been using Gardens & Stuff for monthly maintenance for about three years now. They're not the cheapest, but they're consistent, friendly, and my garden actually looks nice. They remember what I wanted planted last spring and don't try to push extras. Proper local business.
reviews.author: Margaret W.

reviews.text: Had them out to tidy up before we sold the house. They quoted fair, showed up when they said they would, and the garden looked immaculate on viewing day. No complaints at all. Would use again.
reviews.author: Nick L.

address_sub: Serving all of Bristol and surrounding areas
emergency_banner_text: Need your garden sorted urgently? We often fit emergency clearance and tidy-ups within a week. Get in touch —
footer_description: Gardens & Stuff is a family-run gardening business in Bristol. We handle garden maintenance, design, landscaping, and clearance with reliability and local know-how.
